quotes.text: The Bug 1893864 xpcshell test imports attachmentOnly.eml, a message whose top-level Content-Type is image/png and Content-Disposition is attachment. It asserts listAttachments finds exactly one named attachment, then queries attachment:true with the subject and checks the same message ID. The file is in test/xpcshell/messages and the test is test_ext_messages_attachments.js, following the local extension test and fixture naming pattern. Review accepted and marked testing-approved; no inline change request.
